models.L057: Three representative adequate-stimulus channels only; organs contain other receptors. No thresholds, rates, diagnosis or absolute exclusion of other responses. Retina/ear/skin are location schematics, not single receptor cells.
models.L058: One selected receptor–sensory–CNS–motor–muscle route. Gaps are hypothetical connection switches, not injuries or prognoses. Incoming CNS information can remain when the selected motor connection is off. No conduction times.
models.L059: Polysynaptic withdrawal example with spinal interneuron and ascending brain information branch. Card sequence is functional, not equal time. Omits antagonist inhibition and multiple-muscle coordination; not every reflex has the same wiring. No heat/pain test.
models.L060: Fictional A/B messengers and receptor sets. Arrival in blood is separated from receptor-mediated response; a cell can have both sets. Real intracellular pathways, concentrations, receptor number and timing are omitted.
